track_record.note: From the blind test on real trials. It describes past error and does not adjust this simulated number.
track_record.sentence: Blind test record for semaglutide: Semaglutide phase 2 (12 weeks, 6 results) over-predicted the HbA1c benefit by 0.50 on average: missed; SUSTAIN 2 (56 weeks, 2 results) over-predicted the HbA1c benefit by 0.09 on average: held up.

dose_evidence.sentence: At the nearest dose tested blind (Semaglutide 0.2 mg, Semaglutide phase 2, 12 weeks) the simulator predicted -0.889 and the trial observed -0.4, so it over-predicted the HbA1c benefit by 0.49.

validation_scope: Kidney behaviour was tested only for empagliflozin at eGFR 30 to 90.
not_modelled: Hypoglycaemia is not modelled. Risk rises with sulfonylureas or insulin.
Cardiovascular and kidney outcomes are not simulated.
